provenance.recovery: Evidence summaries regenerated from the hash-verified original CI ZIP after transient workspace loss; screenshot bytes unchanged.

measurementScope.kind: Actual browser and loopback-server observations using synthetic fixtures
measurementScope.tracked: Only catalogue_delivery_v2 plus /assets/catalogue-images/; excludes wiring-kit RPC and other static page resources.
measurementScope.bodyBytes: Server body bytes after fixture gzip for JSON; PNGs not HTTP-gzipped. Interrupted responses may have status but no complete body.
measurementScope.cdp: Chrome CDP encodedDataLength; may include protocol overhead, not TLS or billing-grade bytes.
measurementScope.cache: Native Chrome HTTP cache was enabled; no request interception. Metadata warm reuse includes application/session cache.
measurementScope.total: allFixtureServerResponseBodyBytes separately includes all observed local responses; fixture static resources use no-store. Not production CDN behaviour.
